description: Browse the miniapp market collapsed to one row per app (author+name) instead of one row per published version. Each row shows the CURRENT version (whatever GET /apps/:author/:name/bundle serves right now) plus how many versions exist behind it — use GET /apps/:author/:name/versions for the full history and POST /apps/:author/:name/rollback to change which one is current. Each row also carries its store listing's title, kind, category and icon_url (set_app_listing), like list_apps.

offset.description: Pagination offset over the underlying flat list

name: list_apps_grouped
title: List apps by name
